title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation

title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
whyItMatters: LLMs often keep generating reasoning tokens even when explicitly told not to think, revealing mode confusion.
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. We study LLMs' no-thinking behavior along two axes. a. How to measure no-thinking? Prior work typically defines no-thinking through proxies such as a disabled thinking mode or the absence of long traces. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable advances in complex reasoning. In this study, we therefore ask: how far can reasoning supervision be compressed without sacrificing capability? SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
whyItMatters: SpatialASM introduces Active Spatial Mentalization to improve how vision-language models handle spatial reasoning.
summary: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but a single trajectory realizes only one continuation at each decision, limiting supervision coverage under a finite sampling budget. title: VIS-Ground: Video Interactive Storytelling with Contextual Grounding
